tasks: all 18; unchanged full legal pools, no pair-only specialist
initialization: identical prepared fresh R77 seed2 parameters and TRAIN geometry statistics; no trained selector initialization
model: original R77 complete selector with the same R88 B_execution_anchor TSP input rule in both arms
role_selection_reason: known deployment-input completeness, not interim R88 metrics or TEST-based selection
objective: unchanged R77: 0.35 native CE + 0.35 comparison + 0.02 relative-gap risk + original ramped R-Drop

A_adamw.optimizer: actual torch.optim.AdamW on the original parameter order

B_muon_hybrid.adamw_parameters: all remaining parameters, including input/condition/geometry/solver mappings, embeddings, normalization, biases and final scalar output

learning_rate: same successful-update cosine schedule from1e-4 to1e-6 after4320 warmup updates; no LR/WD search
gradient_transaction: sum all real logical1024 microbatch gradients, unscale and clip once, then one optimizer step; no per-micro Muon transformation
AMP: unchanged FP16 model forward; failed gradient attempts retry the same RNG/batch without advancing optimizer state
execution: two already allocated gpu05 4090s after R87 full rc0 delivery, four CPU/nine GiB per arm; no environment upgrade
training_engine: immutable R84 loop in an isolated namespace with explicit optimizer constructor injection; shared modules and global torch.optim.AdamW remain unchanged
batch_and_task_order: same deterministic natural full18 order and exact logical batches
checkpoint_selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct using TRAIN-fitted SBS; first exact tie retained
formal_evaluation: one VAL-selected checkpoint and fixed inference rule per arm, then complete same-version TEST and both LIBs
inference: same full-pool score differences/maximin and execution-role rule; optimizer adds no inference component
empirical_screen: B improves VAL macro Top1 with no mean_cost or actual-regret increase versus matched A and historical same-data R84A
mechanism_metrics: TRAIN/VAL winner discrimination, fixed R84 target rescues/lost/new false picks, precision, recall and paired cost changes; actual matrix-step diagnostics are not success metrics
source_provenance: official single-device Muon primitives pinned by implementation owner plus documented Moonshot RMS scaling; no claim of full LLM-paper reproduction
compatibility_boundary: published PyTorch2.5.1/AMP compatibility was unknown; require focused actual CPU checks and a bounded real GPU full18 witness, never silently substitute another optimizer
hypothesis_boundary: change update-spectrum geometry without class-frequency weighting; useful weak directions, improved Top1 or cost are not guaranteed
declined_option: SD/logit-confidence penalty reviewed but not run; this protocol is optimizer-only
